title: Henry Ford, violinist, and playing drums before trumpet
summary: He knew two Henry Fords, played drums for about two years with the younger violinist, then switched to trumpet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah, I knew them. Henry Ford, tell you the truth, if you're talking about the elder days, two Henry Fords, a young one and an older one. And the young one, he was a violinist. And I played drums with him for quite a while, you know, he had three or four, he didn't have a big orchestra, three or four people. And I played drums with him, Henry Ford, the young one. And the older one? And I knew the father, I knew the older one. What did he play? He was a bass violin player. Uh-huh, I see.

When you said you started playing drums in 1930, how long did you play drums for yourself? I didn't play too long, about two years, I think. And you started, you mean professionally, you were playing with bands? Yeah, yeah, yeah. And then you switched to the trumpet.
Switching the trumpet on account of what I told you, it was too much trouble to get around,
